url.label: Akvorado Console URL
url.description: HTTP(S) address of the Akvorado Console API.

filter.label: Additional traffic filter
filter.description: Optional Akvorado filter ANDed with the boundary condition of each screen. TRAFFIC, FLOWS and PEAK use external OR internal; DOWNL uses external; UPL uses internal.

interval.label: Data refresh (seconds)
interval.description: How often to fetch fresh TRAFFIC and FLOWS data from Akvorado. Independent of screen rotation.

window_minutes.label: Graph + PEAK window (minutes)
window_minutes.description: Historical period for the graph and PEAK value (highest traffic bucket in this period). Default 5 minutes.

average_seconds.label: Rate average (seconds)
average_seconds.description: Time window for the moving average displayed by TRAFFIC, DOWNL, UPL and FLOWS (default 30 seconds). PEAK is the maximum raw bucket over Graph + PEAK window.

auto_rotate.label: Automatically rotate screens
auto_rotate.description: On: rotate only enabled screens in order TRAFFIC, DOWNL, UPL, FLOWS, PEAK. Off: use the wheel to switch manually.

switch_seconds.label: Screen switch (seconds)
switch_seconds.description: Seconds each enabled screen stays visible during auto rotation. Independent from Akvorado data refresh.

show_traffic.label: Show TRAFFIC
show_traffic.description: Show total L3 traffic (external + internal) as a moving average. White value, grey label.

show_downl.label: Show DOWNL
show_downl.description: Show only InIfBoundary = external, averaged over the same period as TRAFFIC. Green value and graph.

show_upl.label: Show UPL
show_upl.description: Show only InIfBoundary = internal, averaged over the same period as TRAFFIC. Blue-violet value and graph.

show_flows.label: Show FLOWS
show_flows.description: Show flow records per second, external + internal, using the moving average.

show_peak.label: Show PEAK
show_peak.description: Show the highest total L3 traffic bucket from the Graph + PEAK window (not the moving average).
